radiology_report:
LUMC Leiden Radiology | 20 February 2025
Modality: Multiparametric MRI Prostate
Indication: 74-year-old male with PSA 82.0 ng/mL, prior positive biopsy, and suspected malignancy.

FINDINGS:
The gland measures 64.0 mL total volume. T2 sequences show a circumscribed, hypointense focus in the right mid-gland peripheral zone spanning 22 × 18 × 15 mm. Diffusion-weighted imaging exhibits pronounced restriction with a corresponding ADC drop. Post-contrast phases demonstrate prompt, focal hyperenhancement compared to adjacent tissue. Capsular integrity remains intact; seminal vesicles are clear. Pelvic nodes show normal dimensions. Skeletal evaluation reveals no suspicious osseous foci.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 64.0 mL; PSA density 1.281 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.9339169.
